purpose: Prospective feasibility diagnostic of speech contamination screening, not data-center source identification, quality calibration or final field evaluation

model.inference: Existing pinned ORT-Web 1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0, WASM, one thread, sequential, fixed SIMD

fixedPolicy.maximumSpeechDuration: infinity as upstream; bounded by capture length
fixedPolicy.tail: Pad only final inference frame to512 with zeros; timestamps clamp to real recording length
fixedPolicy.processing: No gain normalization, no denoising, state and context reset before each recording
fixedPolicy.decision: At least one qualifying speech interval -> Possible speech interference; no interval -> No speech flagged, never verified speech absence

resampling: New standalone 16kHz polyphase Kaiser(beta5) FIR, halfLength10*max(up,down), zero extension, Float32 multiply/sum, no gain adjustment; compare independent SciPy1.15.3 resample_poly before browser model queries

developmentInputs.priorAnnotation: No speech detected by separate annotation pipeline; edited outside/inside comparison, not independent truth
No speech detected by separate annotation pipeline; edited before/after comparison
No speech detected by separate annotation pipeline
Non-data-center cooling comparator, no speech detected by separate annotation pipeline
Narrated control, two speech intervals previously found

developmentInputs.scope: 30s waveform with narrated control excerpt at20s
developmentInputs.priorAnnotation: Software coverage fixture, not natural field data

repetition: Each browser recording is rerun once to verify reset/repeatability; fixed model/policy never adjusted based on results
reporting: Retain raw per-frame scores, exact parameters, source/PCM/model/runtime hashes and raw intervals in ignored research output. Publish compact aggregate metadata only; raw recordings remain out of public assets. No CLAP calls, no old416 holdout calls, no training.
limits: A voice detector can miss distant, masked or very short speech and can flag machinery incorrectly.
No speech flagged does not prove correct equipment capture or a data-center source.
All INVC clips are one provider cluster and do not establish site-disjoint field accuracy.
